blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Mark Villar is pushing for mandatory free health maintenance organization (HMO) coverage for government employees to shield them and their families from costly health emergencies. “Our government employees are valuable partners for promoting progress and bringing services to the public. It’s just right that their health and welfare are ensured, especially in times they are ill or during medical emergencies,” Villar said in a statement on Tuesday. According to. him, the coverage that the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. provides them may not fully cover hospitalization, treatment, and other medical expenses, leaving employees to shoulder potentially high out-of-pocket costs.
